issue_summary: Make URLValidator reject invalid characters in the username and password
primary_concern: Unencoded second colon in userinfo password must be invalid URL; failures http://foo:bar:baz@example.com and IPv6 user:pa:ss.

issue_summary: utils.numberformat.format renders small decimals in exponential notation.
primary_concern: Negative tiny Decimal values whose magnitude falls below display resolution must print 0.00 rather than -0.00.

issue_summary: django.utils.http.parse_http_date two digit year check is incorrect
primary_concern: When current year is 2099, RFC850 date 01-Jan-00 must be interpreted as 2000 (test expectation).
A get_phase_display override inherited from a mixin must be honored instead of regenerated choice display.

issue_summary: Resetting primary key for a child model doesn't work.
primary_concern: Setting Congressman.pk to old_pk+7 must immediately update politician_id parent-link field.

issue_summary: Enumeration Types are not usable in templates.
primary_concern: Even if subclass defines do_not_call_in_templates=False, Choices metaclass must force it True or error.
get_child_arguments must preserve -m singlemodule when __spec__.name is singlemodule; synthetic __main__ with parent should use its parent.

issue_summary: RenameModel with db_table should be a noop.
primary_concern: When explicit db_table remains unchanged on model rename, database_forwards should execute no schema queries despite FK/M2M relations.

issue_summary: MigrationRecorder does not obey db_router allow_migrate rules
primary_concern: MigrationExecutor._create_project_state must be called with with_applied_migrations=False if plan=[] and migrations table missing.

issue_summary: Allow ModelForm meta to specify formfield_callback.
primary_concern: A class-level staticmethod callback must be ignored in favor of Meta.formfield_callback; ModelForm construction must not raise TypeError.

issue_summary: ModelAdmin.lookup_allowed() incorrectly raises DisallowedModelAdminLookup lookup with foreign key as primary key
primary_concern: A bare related lookup not explicitly included in list_filter must be disallowed even if a subfield path is listed.
Text.update_from must copy antialiased property, and Cairo GC true antialiasing should yield a mode other than ANTIALIAS_NONE.

issue_summary: Matrix determinant raises Invalid NaN comparison with particular symbolic entries
primary_concern: random_complex_number(rational=True, tolerance=1e-3) must be supported by random-number utility.
Mod(3*k, 2) simplifies to Mod(k, 2); Mod(6*i, 9) equals 3*Mod(2*i, 3) for integer i.

issue_summary: SI._collect_factor_and_dimension() cannot properly detect that exponent is dimensionless
primary_concern: SI._collect_factor_and_dimension(F(dimless_expr, dim_expr)) must return a 3-tuple (factor, dim1, dim2).
